title: The Two-Hand Intermediate Course
summary: Adds qi to the two-hand cuts a student already knows and teaches how to ride the blade's swing with the feet

title: Principles of the Heavy Cut
summary: Sets out why a heavy cut needs the whole body behind it and how qi lets a guard hold under its recoil

title: A Treatise on Edge and Weight
summary: Studies how edge angle and blade weight work together and teaches two qi-driven cuts that use both

title: The Great Blade Practice Canon
summary: A full practice canon for warriors who guard and strike with qi through three intermediate sequences

title: Manual of Momentum and Recovery
summary: Teaches a student to turn the momentum of one swing into the next and to recover the guard between them

title: Forms for the Circulating Student
summary: The longest intermediate course in the stock with ten forms that join qi circulation to every basic greatsword action

title: Handbook of Binding and Release
summary: Covers the bind of crossed blades and the qi-assisted release that throws the opponent's weapon aside

title: The Long Edge Companion
summary: A companion text on using the full length of the blade and carrying qi out to its tip

title: Course in Sweep and Thrust
summary: Teaches the wide sweep and the long thrust as a pair with three intermediate moves that join them

title: A Primer of Leverage and Guard
summary: Shows how the long hilt acts as a lever for guards and binds and adds two moves that use it with qi
